title: Fake Names Won’t Get You Far with Police
description:
Lying to police usually makes things worse...

On May 7, 2021, an officer noticed a red Dodge Ram going the wrong way down a one-way street in La Crosse, WI. The driver verbally identified herself but had trouble remembering what her date of birth was. After multiple attempts to get her correct information, the officer questioned her identity.
